item.title: Lake View Earns Straight 1s at UIL State Mariachi Festival
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Lake View High School earned straight 1s at the UIL State Mariachi Festival on Thursday for the fourth straight year.All three judges awarded a 1 to Lake View for its performance, which can be seen here. Learn More Here.

item.title: DPS Trooper Hospitalized, 1 Suspect Dead After Officer-Involved Shooting in Big Spring
item.description: BIG SPRING, TX — A Texas Department of Public Safety trooper was shot and hospitalized in stable condition, and one suspect was killed after an early morning officer-involved shooting in Big Spring on Monday, authorities said. Learn More Here.

item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Emergency responders were dispatched Sunday night to a commercial structure fire at 1214 W. Beauregard Ave., where flames were contained to the garage area with no injuries reported. Learn More Here.

item.title: WATCH: Angelo State Names New Women's Soccer Head Coach
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX – Angelo State University has announced the hiring of Harold Munoz as the fifth head coach in the history of its women’s soccer program.Munoz, a native of Bogota, Colombia, has served as the Rambelles' assistant coach for the past nine seasons, helping guide the Rambelles to seven Lone Star Conference titles and five appearances in the NCAA Tournament. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State's Esquivel Named LSC's OPOW for 2nd Straight Week
item.description: RICHARDSON, TX — The Lone Star Conference has named Angelo State’s Majik Esquivel Offensive Player of the Week for the second consecutive week and the third time this season, the league announced Monday.Esquivel, a sophomore from Lubbock, averaged 25 points, 5.5 rebounds and 2.5 assists during an unbeaten week for the Rambelles against No. 23 Lubbock Christian and Midwestern State. She shot 53.5% from the field and went 8 for 8 at the free-throw line, adding one steal and one block. Learn More H

item.title: Forsan Flies Past Ballinger Late for Bi-District Playoff Win
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — It’s hard to tell by the final score, but the Forsan and Ballinger boys were in an absolute dogfight for much of their first-round playoff game Monday night at Angelo State’s Junell Center.In a back-and-forth battle, Ballinger led by a point midway through the third quarter before Forsan turned on the afterburners and ran away with an 89-65 win. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 14 Wall Takes Down Brady to Claim Bi-District Championship
item.description: EDEN, TX — The No. 14 Wall Hawks clashed with the Brady Bulldogs in the Bi-District Round of the playoffs in Eden on Monday night. The Bulldogs proved to be stiff competition early before the Hawks slowly pulled away in the 2nd half. Wall claimed victory and advanced, 64-31. Learn More Here.
